text_to_speech: How to alphabetize your reference list in Microsoft Word The first thing to do is highlight all of your references, then under the "Home" tab, go to the "A-to-Z Sort" icon button. Leave the "Sort By" drop-down as "Paragraphs" and click OK. Now all of your references are in alphabetical order.

timecoded_text_to_speech.text: How to alphabetize your reference list in Microsoft Word.
First thing to do is highlight all of your references.
Then, under the Home tab, go to the A to Z Swort icon button.
Leave the sort by drop down as paragraphs and click OK.
Now all of your references are in alphabetical order.
